title: Tesla Registered 285 Cybercabs In One Day

sentences.text: Tesla just registered two hundred eighty-five Cybercabs in one day.
A new record. The old mark was about two hundred.
Texas now lists eleven hundred and seven. First time past one thousand.
Tesla has eighteen hundred forty-one robotaxis there. Waymo has fourteen hundred nine.
About sixty percent of that fleet has no steering wheel.
These cars carry riders in Austin and Dallas.
Registered does not mean every one is giving rides yet.
